opportunities.title: Main Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based organisations; applicants must have formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration; excludes individuals without such ties, schools, undergraduates, master’s students, PhD fee projects, establishment of academic posts, and ongoing costs.
opportunities.summary: Funding of up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases) for research that addresses one or more of the Foundation’s priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications welcomed; applicants are typically UK‑based organisations.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and aims to contribute to understanding and addressing racial inequalities.
